newsitem.title: UK: Ugland orders 34 mln stg car ships.
newsitem.headline: Ugland orders 34 mln stg car ships.

text.p: Ugland International Plc, the British shipping group, said on Monday it was investing 34 million pounds in a new car-carrying ship after signing a contract with Japan's Tsuneishi shipyard.
The contract includes the option for building two more similar vessels, each of which will be able to carry 6,100 cars on 12 decks, Ugland said in a statement.
The expected delivery date of the first carrier is May 1999 and any additional ones in 2000. Confirmation of the options is due in December 1997.
If all options are exercised, Ugland's vehicle carrier fleet will increase to 15 vessels with a value of around 202 million stg, the group said.
"The performance of our core business of vehicle transportation continues to be healthy," said chairman Andreas Ugland.
"Our planned new building programme should enable us to maintain a leading position in this industry, which has consistently produced good returns over the long term."
